segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נָדְרָה וְהִיא אֲרוּסָה. נִתְגָּרְשָׁה בּוֹ בַּיּוֹם, נִתְאָרְסָה בּוֹ בַּיּוֹם, אֲפִילּוּ לְמֵאָה — אָבִיהָ וּבַעְלָהּ הָאַחֲרוֹן מְפִירִין נְדָרֶיהָ. זֶה הַכְּלָל: כֹּל שֶׁלֹּא יָצְאָה לִרְשׁוּת עַצְמָהּ שָׁעָה אַחַת — אָבִיהָ וּבַעְלָהּ הָאַחֲרוֹן מְפִירִין נְדָרֶיהָ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «she took a vow as a betrothed woman» and then «was divorced on the same day,» and «she was» again «betrothed on the same day» to another man, or «even to one hundred» men, one after the other, on a single day, «her father and her last husband nullify her vows. This is the principle:» With regard to «any» young woman «who has not left» her father’s jurisdiction and entered «into her own jurisdiction for» at least «one moment,» through full marriage or reaching majority, «her father and her final husband nullify her vows.»

moves.summary: even after a hundred betrothals in one day, father and last betrothed nullify
general rule: whoever has not left to her own authority

positions.claim: as long as she has not left to her own authority for a moment, her father and last betrothed nullify her vows
